overall_notes: The paper thoroughly evaluates text revision tasks using both traditional metrics and LLM-as-judge approaches. The extraction was generally good but contained some duplicates and inconsistent naming. Key contributions include proposing LLM-as-judge methods (LLM-Choice and LLM-Likert) and identifying ParaPLUIE as a cost-effective alternative metric.
